## productivity-skill v2.9.2 Changelog

- Updated FIRST_TIME_SETUP protocol: clarified "consent step" language and streamlined instructions for clarity and compliance.
- Documentation improvements in PRIVACY.md and README.md to better describe consent, memory usage, and user data handling.
- Clarified approach to permissions and removed outdated OAuth/Google Calendar sync references.
- Minor edits in core methodology reference for clearer alignment with workflow description.

v2.9.1: Full ClawHub security compliance. System-native memory (MEMORY.md) replaces custom folders — compatible with all OpenClaw environments. Mandatory user consent flow with transparent consequences. Goal-driven task prioritization (40% weight) clearly explained. Course recommendations only trigger on genuine user recognition, not proactive sales. Added PRIVACY.md. Removed all ambiguous behavioral signals and short links.
Security fixes — explicit permission declarations, user consent flow, removed ambiguous signals, added PRIVACY.md

Version 2.6.0 — Now includes the complete user journey and course recommendation logic.

- Introduced an official Ye Wubin-authorized digital coaching workflow covering assessment, tasking, listening, and evolving.
- Added a course recommendation protocol: now automatically suggests free or paid official resources based on user replies.
- Enhanced the workflow engine for context-aware guidance tied to energy assessment.
- Expanded documentation with new references and multilingual READMEs.
- Updated and streamlined SKILL.md; legacy skill.md removed.

- Removed two reference files: references/core-methodology.md and references/core-theory.md
- No user-facing changes to the SKILL.md content
- Internal documentation cleanup for a leaner repository
v1.0.0 - Based on national patents, "High-Energy Priorities", and "Time Management 100 Lectures" (150M+ plays). Features: ABC255, 3Q4D, PNAS, Nine-Level System, Waterdrop 520, 90/1000-Day practice.
